title: Driver Onboarding | Business Operations | BackOfficeFleet
description: BOF driver onboarding support connects recruiting, DQF handoff, payroll setup, training, safety acknowledgement, and assignment readiness.
html:
Business Operations / Driver Onboarding

Turn a driver candidate into assignment readiness.

Driver onboarding sits between HR, driver qualification, safety, payroll, and dispatch. BOF shows whether the driver file is ready, needs review, or is blocked before the fleet promises an assignment.

Business OperationsDriver Command Center

Onboarding manager lens

The handoff is successful only when dispatch can rely on the file.

Application status, DQF review, training, safety acknowledgement, payroll setup, and equipment needs stay visible in one workflow.

Deep dive

Assignment readiness is the operating test.

The detailed page shows how BOF organizes the release path from intake to first assignment.

Assignment readiness

Know whether the driver can actually be assigned.

Review driver qualification, training, policy acknowledgement, payroll setup, and dispatch release in one operating sequence.

Open Assignment Readiness

Onboarding path

Every onboarding step should point to the next operating action.

A driver is not ready just because a form exists. BOF shows what is complete, what is missing, who owns the next step, and whether dispatch can assign the driver.

Application intake

Collect the candidate profile, contact record, experience notes, prior employer context, and missing intake items.

DQF handoff

Connect driver qualification requirements to the Driver Command Center so missing credentials appear as readiness blockers.

Payroll setup

Track pay basis, direct deposit or contractor packet status, tax form status, and internal review owner.

Assignment release

Show whether safety acknowledgement, training, equipment status, and driver record status allow assignment.

Intake
Collect the candidate record.

Source, contact, experience, license class, preferred lane, missing information, and recruiter owner.

Candidate profile
Clear
Move credentials and acknowledgements into review.

DQF handoff, MVR or medical card status, training, safety acknowledgement, and policy review are tracked.

Ready, review, blocked
Release
Confirm the driver can support an assignment.

Payroll setup, equipment needs, dispatch notes, and assignment release owner are visible before first load.

Assignment ready
